Record the nodes where the workflow is available and warn in case a request is made if this is not case.

```source [redacted]```

will give access to a few functions, the one I would like you to focus on is `setup_spack` which should give access to pre-installed libraries and sources of DD4hep and Geant4 in particular.

Investigate if this is the case.

I’ll inspect the setup script, test `setup_spack` in an isolated shell, and check whether DD4hep and Geant4 libraries and sources are available. I’ll use the skill-creator instructions to record the workflow and node requirements, including the warning to give when it is unavailable.

`setup_spack` activates the expected environment on `acts-mac-studio-01.cern.ch`. Spack lists DD4hep 1.37 and Geant4 11.4.1 as installed. I’m checking imports, retained source trees and Geant4 datasets next—the install list alone doesn’t establish that simulation will run.

The runtime works, with an extra setup step: after `setup_spack`, DD4hep’s `thisdd4hep.sh` is needed for Python imports. DD4hep and DDG4 then import successfully, and Geant4 reports all 12 datasets installed.

Full source trees are not staged for either package: `spack location --source-dir` fails for both. I’ll record runtime and source availability separately so a source-level request gets the appropriate warning.

A C++ smoke test also compiled, linked and ran against DDCore, DDG4 and Geant4. The skill and node registry are ready; their checks warn for unknown nodes, missing prerequisites, changed setup files and unavailable sources.

The [skill-creator instructions]([redacted] say to “create discoverable skills in `$CODEX_HOME/skills`”. Installing the tested copy there requires filesystem approval because it is outside this workspace.

The skill is installed and its node-warning tests pass. The broader dashboard tests exposed a fixture issue: their temporary checkouts don’t include the new `skills/` directory. I’m updating those fixtures to include it, then rerunning the affected checks.

The corrected dashboard tests are passing so far. The installed skill and repository copy match, and the registry fingerprints still match this node’s setup. The recorded result is: DD4hep/Geant4 runtime and development libraries are available here; full source trees are not staged. Other nodes remain unverified.

All 46 local tests now pass, along with the C++ smoke test. The skill is already installed locally; I’m recording the PR metadata.
